items.title: Chevron (CVX) Nears $5 Billion Gulf Deal And Iraq Oilfield Takeover
items.summary: Chevron (NYSE:CVX) has agreed contract terms to take over operations at Iraq's giant West Qurna 2 oilfield, one of the country's largest reserves. The group is also nearing a roughly US$5b transaction to acquire a majority stake in Beacon Offshore Energy's deepwater Gulf of Mexico portfolio. Together, the West Qurna 2 deal and planned Beacon Offshore acquisition reshape Chevron's long term upstream asset mix and risk profile.
